title: Works well, but does not wash as well as hoped
text:
Works well, but does not wash as well as hoped. *UPDATED REVIEW*

Update: seller responded to my original review (below), as you can see from their comment. I called and left a voicemail. The next day, someone from the company called me, and it sounded like they were in the car on a cell phone. When I described the problem, they said they would have someone from their customer service department call me the following day. Never heard from anyone. this was several weeks ago. Lip service only. I am actually knocking off an additional star for this CS fail.

---
This item is the old school rubber bathmat we remember from when we were kids in the 70s. And it still works extremely well--it is exactly the same, and probably the safest, most comfortable non-slip bathmat out there (the best I have found, anyway). I do however have a significant gripe about it: they say you can wash it to get it clean. Nope. It becomes discolored after a couple dozen showers, and stays that way, looking rather unappealing in pretty short order, even after washing (I suppose if you washed it after every shower it would stay looking great, but that's ridiculous). I found that spraying it with bleach and scrubbing helps, but I also worry that the bleach may eventually break down the rubber.
